description: Divisional Secretariat - Matara Four Gravets - Notifying that the Annual Festival of Mother's National Church, Matara will be conducted from 01.09.2016 to 11.09.2016
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the dates for an annual religious festival (Mother's National Church, Matara) under the Pilgrimage Ordinance. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. The content pertains to cultural/religious administrative matters, making it fall under Miscellaneous (Type 10).
